title: Avijeet Thakur | Web Developer, SEO and AI Automation
metaDescription: Web developer with product management experience: WordPress, Shopify and custom builds, SEO and speed, and AI automations. 5+ years of client work.
h1: I build websites and automations around your business goals
lead: I'm a web developer who works like a product manager: I ask what each page is for before I build it. I use code, WordPress and Shopify, and I add AI automations when they'll save you time.
fine: Send a short brief. I reply with a plan.

who.title: Who I am
paragraphs: I'm Avijeet Thakur, a web developer who also works like a product manager. I've been building websites and stores for more than five years, mostly in WordPress and Shopify, with SEO and speed work on every build.
I did product work alongside the code: user research, sprint planning, writing requirements. At Tender Suvidha that meant helping a B2B SaaS product keep its users and win new subscribers.

These days I also build AI automations, like a voice agent that books appointments and a chatbot that qualifies leads. Most projects I build myself. When one needs more hands, I bring in people I trust and stay your point of contact.

what.title: From first brief to a live site
what.intro: I take a site from the first conversation to launch, and I stay on to look after it.
steps: You and I agree what the site has to do, which pages it needs and what people will search for.
I design from your Figma file or my own wireframes, then build a working version you can click through.
I set up SEO, speed, hosting and tracking, then go live.
I keep it updated and fix what breaks. When you want something new, I add it.

why.title: What you get when you work with me
why.intro: Here's what working with me looks like.
reasons: You talk to me, the person who plans and builds your site. If a project needs more people, I bring them in and stay your single contact, so nothing gets lost between a designer, a developer and an SEO.
I ask what a page is for
I've worked in product, so I start with what each page has to achieve and how you'll know it did.
Speed and SEO from day one
They go into the build from the start, not in a rush after launch.
The sites I talk about are live. Open them and judge for yourself.
You get a plan first, a staging site to click through, and updates while I build.

services.title: What I can build for you

faq.title: Questions people ask me first
items: Business websites, online stores, and the front and back end of web apps, plus AI automations. Most of my work is on WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify, with custom code when a project needs it.
You send a short brief through the form. I reply with questions and a plan. Once you and I have agreed scope, price and timeline in writing, I start.
Most projects I build myself. When a project needs more hands, I bring in people I trust and stay your point of contact, so you only ever deal with me.
Can you work from my designs?
Yes. I turn Figma designs into responsive pages. If you don't have designs, I can work from wireframes.
I already have a site. Can you help?
Yes. I check what's slowing it down or holding back its SEO, fix it, and I can take over the upkeep.
Will my site rank on Google?
I build SEO into every page, but I don't promise positions. Rankings depend on your competition and on time.
It depends on the scope. I quote per project after I've read your brief.
Do you work with agencies and teams?
Yes, on contract or by the project.
faq.sideText: Send your question with your contact details and I'll answer by email.

cta.title: Have something to build?
cta.text: Send your name, email and phone number. I'll reply by email with questions and a plan.
